analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported strong growth in H1 FY27, with pre-sales reaching INR879 crores and EBITDA margins expanding to 39.9% in Q2. The company maintains a net cash position of INR494 crores and continues to focus on redevelopment projects in Mumbai. Management plans to launch four new projects in H2 FY27 with an estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores. The company remains confident in achieving its FY27 guidance for pre-sales, revenue, and PAT growth. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported robust financial and operational performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, driven by strong pre-sales growth and higher profitability.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain EBITDA margins between 35% and 40% and PAT margins between 25% and 30%.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company expects pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels for FY27.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 pre-sales guidance ranging between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are expected to be between 35% to 40% for the full year.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Management believes the luxury segment is less sensitive to interest rate hikes compared to affordable housing.
demand_outlook.quote: While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

demand_outlook.claim: The company does not expect the recent repo rate hike to materially alter demand in its operating micromarkets.
demand_outlook.quote: We, therefore, do not expect it to materially alter demand in the micromarkets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces in the GIFT City project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai is a good example of this. Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained. There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that luxury buyers are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle rather than loan rates.
demand_outlook.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not. They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has observed price rises of about 5% to 10% in its markets.
demand_outlook.quote: So, as far as price rise is concerned, it's about 5% to 10% we have seen the price rise.

demand_outlook.claim: The company achieves pricing in its micro-market that is 10% to 15% higher than other developers.
demand_outlook.quote: So, regarding the pricing related to other developers, so normally in our micro-market we are getting 10% to 15% higher than the other developers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added three new projects during the quarter, increasing its pipeline GDV by INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four projects in H2 FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: Four launches are planned for the second half including Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of approximately INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.
capex_expansion.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 39.9% for Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs in Q2.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 39.9% in Q2 FY27 compared to 28.6% in Q2 FY26.
Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

margins_costs.claim: The company's average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot.
margins_costs.quote: Our average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot, underscoring the strength of our product across the micro-markets we operate in.

margins_costs.claim: Sales and marketing expenses are approximately 1% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: Of course, our expense would be I would say about 1% approximately, but that also will be able to recover because what happens that during this advertising, there would be many clients we will be getting directly, where we will not be spending any money on brokerage.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's ongoing and upcoming pipeline consists of 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs.

orders_capacity.claim: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year for Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company held a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Fresh issue proceeds from the IPO of INR 792 Crs are used for investment in subsidiaries for part-funding development and construction costs of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for subsidiaries from IPO net proceeds, INR271 crores has been deployed as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that collections are linked to construction milestones and can vary quarter-to-quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Collections in our business are linked to construction milestones and can vary from quarter-to-quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to complete three projects in the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, at the time of the completion stage, the collection always be the 90%, 95% is due. So that's reflect in the balance sheet. The same will be you'll see that once the project will be completed, so next year we are aiming that three projects will be completed
